name: getblogged
description: Get Blogged by JoKi - Personal blog and technical articles

scripts.build: npm run clean && docfx build posts/docfx.json && python3 scripts/generate-clean-markdown.py
scripts.build:draft: npm run clean && python3 scripts/generate-draft-index.py && docfx build posts/docfx.draft.json && python3 scripts/generate-clean-markdown.py --draft
scripts.serve: npm run clean && docfx build posts/docfx.json --serve
scripts.serve:draft: npm run clean && python3 scripts/generate-draft-index.py && docfx build posts/docfx.draft.json --serve
scripts.deploy: npm run predeploy && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting

author: Jochen Kirstätter
